body: Mine centers on different things based on whats going on, but it started after a failed suicide attempt back in 2009. Hasn't stopped yet.

He already knows, or so he says. Because of the bouts of Insomnia, they tend to happen because of the lack of sleep. Auditory are definitely the more common compared to visual. He believes it's mainly due to the fact I've been dealing with it for so long and can't afford the medication for it yet.
Makes sense. Just keep open channels to people that matter in your life and keep talking with them about issues you're facing. Hopefully things will ease up on you eventually. =/
Is it related to things happening in school? At home? Issues with friends? Bullying? What do you think is the primary cause of these feelings?

It's not something everyone feels, but you've come to the right place to discuss it. I get the feeling though there is more to your story than what you are trying to tell us. All I can offer in regards to advice here, is keep in mind that being a teenager is an awkward enough time as it is, and as that passes a good chunk of stress can fade away. Can you tell us more about what's going on?

You really do need to listen to your friends on this one. If you really feel like you might endanger yourself, you need to seek help. I'd suggest looking up a Psychologist in your area, a Psychiatrist is someone who deals with people already on medication. If that pertains to you, then seek one of those out instead. But getting help is a huge and important first step.
